observations: Photo 0 shows a black Nikon DSLR camera with a lens attached, placed on a wooden surface. The camera body has 'Nikon' visible on the front. A red box labeled '6.35 mm' is in the background.
Photo 1 shows a close-up of the camera's top right, with the 'Nikon' logo visible. The lens cap is on, and the camera appears to be in a dark environment.
Photo 2 shows a close-up of the camera's top left, with 'D610' clearly visible on the body. The 'FX' logo is also visible. The camera has a textured grip and various buttons and dials.
All photos have a watermark 'CDICSON BUSINESS WORLD'.

claims.claim: The Nikon D610 is a full-frame DSLR camera known for its 24.3-megapixel FX-format...
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows 'D610' and 'FX' logo, confirming it is a full-frame camera. The 24.3-megapixel claim is standard for this model and not visible in the photos.

risks.risk: The camera may be non-functional or have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, menu navigation, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: The lens may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens glass and mount, showing no cracks or fogging, and a video of the lens attaching to the camera.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens not included or damaged

risks.risk: The camera may have been tampered with or have a non-original battery or charger.
risks.proof: A photo of the battery and charger, and a video showing the battery charging and the camera powering on.
risks.if_unproven: priced as battery and charger not included

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Close-up photo of the lens glass and mount.
Photo of the battery and charger.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
